heuristic_notes.identity_variation: content-token recall >=0.50, anchor recall >=0.80 (or no anchors), and source bigram coverage <0.80
heuristic_notes.role_reexpression: identity_variation plus any event-marker, pronoun-set, passive-cue, anchor-order, or preposition-set shift
heuristic_notes.property_narrow: can/cannot + has/have/had + selected multiword COMPS-like frames; excludes generic copula from the narrow total
heuristic_notes.state_total: sum of explicit movement, transfer, change, and containment verb-form lexicons
heuristic_notes.command_frames: literal Entity-like move...from...to, remove...from, put...into, and contains within limited windows
